comment: Passkeys (ADR-0066, ADR-0069): the WebAuthn RP-ID is the apex circletools.ch (Auth:Passkey:ServerDomain), so Android Credential Manager fetches THIS file to authorize the app's passkeys. get_login_creds is the relation passkeys require; the Secret-Santa Android app authenticates against this RP. This app uses Play App Signing WITH KEY ROTATION, so every signing identity the device may present is listed (Credential Manager validates whatever PackageManager reports as the app's signer, which for a rotated app need not equal the APK's embedded cert). Entries: FD:D7… = CURRENT app signing key (Play Console); BB:EF… = PREVIOUS app signing key (Play Console); 45:A8… = the signature PackageManager reports on-device (adb dumpsys package > Signatures) for the installed build — kept because GMS appears to validate that identity, and listing a non-matching but well-formed SHA-256 is harmless. All read 2026-10-06. Add more apps' packages here as they ship.
